content: क्षोदः [क्षुद्-घञ्] .²1 Pounding, grinding. .²2 The stone on which anything is ground or powdered, a mortar. .²3 Any ground substance, flour. .²4 Dust, particle, any small or minute particle; वीचीवातैः शीकरक्षोदशीतैः <ls>U. 3. 2</ls>. कीर्णैः पिष्टातकौघैः कृतदिवसमुखैः कुङ्कुमक्षोदगौरैः <ls>Ratn. 1. 9</ls>. .²5 A drop. .²6 A lump, piece. .²7 Multiplication.
